title: Envelope
description: The versioned envelope that every emitted event uses (REQ-CTR-001). The same JSON is produced by Go and Python (REQ-CNF-003). The schema is closed (additionalProperties is false) where it is written, so a producer never emits a field the contract does not name; a consumer is tolerant and ignores the unknown fields of later MINOR versions (REQ-VER-004). The extension point is attributes. The size limit of a whole event (64 KiB) is a rule of the library (T-03.5), not a schema keyword.

schema_version.description: The version of the contract, MAJOR.MINOR. It starts at 0.1 and reaches 1.0 with the library.

event_id.description: A UUIDv7 in lowercase. It is globally unique and is never derived from a timestamp alone (REQ-CTR-009). The receiver deduplicates by it.

event_type.description: The type in the notation domain.entity.action, from the registry in contracts/events/ (for example log.entry.recorded).

occurred_at.description: When the data was generated at the source. The consumer may give it; otherwise it is the time of the call. When the data carries observed_at it equals it (REQ-CTR-008).

recorded_at.description: When the library accepted the event. Only the library sets it, from its clock; the consumer never does (REQ-CTR-008, ADR-012).

data.description: The payload, typed by event_type. It may be empty. This is the generic schema, an open object; the schema of each event type narrows it (contracts/schemas, T-02.3).

utc_time.description: An instant in UTC, RFC 3339 with the zone Z and exactly six decimals: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ (REQ-CNF-003).
